text:
Priya: Heads up, I opened a small PR (4321) to update the streaming SDK example; needs a docs preview and one reviewer before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321

Alex: I can review but preview is failing right now. Getting link-check errors.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build failed on PR 4321 - step `link-check` exited with code 1. Log snippet: 
``nERROR: /site/content/sdk/streaming.md: broken link to /assets/sdk/old-streaming.png
```

Tessa: That image was renamed in an earlier PR. Priya, did you update the path in the example?

Priya: I swapped the filename to streaming-v2.png locally and tested `make preview` — it passes locally but CI still fails.

Sam: Likely the preview job pulls assets from staging S3; local preview uses working-dir files. @Docs Rotation Bot any asset pipeline changes lately?

Docs Rotation Bot: Last static-assets deploy: 7 days ago (2026-03-14). No known breaking changes.

Alex: Two quick fixes: (A) push a tiny change to the md to retrigger preview, or (B) a reviewer with deploy creds can force a rebuild. I can review if CI goes green.

Tessa: I don't have rebuild perms. Priya, can you push?

Priya: Pushed a small commit updating the image path and adding an HTML comment to touch the file. Triggered preview build.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build started for PR 4321.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build failed on PR 4321 - step `asset-collector` exited with code 2. Log: 
``nERROR: asset-collector: missing asset streaming-v2.png in S3 bucket staging-assets-1
```

Sam: Confirmed: preview pulls from S3 staging, and the new PNG wasn't uploaded. Priya, did you add the PNG to the repo or only reference it?

Priya: I added it under /static/assets and committed, but we rely on a separate asset upload job to push to S3. I forgot that.

Alex: Fastest options: upload the asset to staging S3 (requires creds) or change the example to a CDN-hosted image so preview doesn't need staging. Which is quicker?

Priya: CDN change is faster. I'll replace the path with the existing hosted image `https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/streaming.png` and re-run preview.

Priya: Pushed 4321+cdn-fallback and triggered preview.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build started for PR 4321.

CI Bot: docs-preview: build succeeded for PR 4321.

Alex: Good, starting review now.

Tessa: If review is quick can we merge before EOD? Product demo depends on this snippet.

Alex: Left one tiny nit on example wording, non-blocking. Will approve after that change.

Priya: Updated wording per nit.

Alex: Approved :thumbsup: 

Sam: Two ops follow-ups: (1) Priya, please open an asset-upload ticket so staging gets the PNG for future previews; (2) rotation team: add a backup reviewer with staging/upload perms because previews can stall if the reviewer on duty lacks those creds.

Docs Rotation Bot: Noted. Adding backup reviewer slot in next rotation.

Priya: Merged the PR. Thanks everyone.

Tessa: Thanks — demo unblocked :party_parrot: 

Sam: Filing follow-up ticket: https://go.redwood/ISSUE-789 (assigning to Priya for asset upload).

Priya: I'll handle the ticket tomorrow morning.

Alex: Quick retro: (a) If preview fails due to assets, prefer CDN fallback for docs-only images; (b) when adding new static assets, include the asset-upload step in the PR checklist; (c) ensure rotation has at least one reviewer with staging perms.

Tessa: I'll add a short blurb to docs-ops checklist and ping rotation leads.

Priya: Closing loop — PR merged and demo unblocked. Thanks for quick responses!
